meta.title: The Bridge That Fell for a Song

analysis.title: The Bridge That Fell for a Song
sentences: The Bridge That Fell for a Song.
In 1831, the town of Broughton was proud of its new iron bridge.
Seventy-four soldiers marched across it in step, boots ringing on the deck.
The bridge began to sway with every step.
The deck folded into the river.
Unluckily, the whole town had to walk the long way round for a year.
A child on a swing knows the trick: a small push at the right moment grows into a huge arc.
Afterward, armies were told to break step on bridges.
The bridge was rebuilt with a sign, but the sign did not mention the song.

Seventy-four soldiers marched across it in step, boots ringing on the deck. The bridge began to sway with every step.
A bolt snapped. The deck folded into the river.
Luckily, nobody drowned. Unluckily, the whole town had to walk the long way round for a year.
A child on a swing knows the trick: a small push at the right moment grows into a huge arc. The soldiers were the push.
Afterward, armies were told to break step on bridges. The bridge was rebuilt with a sign, but the sign did not mention the song.
